ExcerptText: Tickets arrive via three channels: support@example.test email inbox, self-service portal form, and escalation-tagged copy from billing team.
Notes: Verbatim quote of intake channels; evidence for C-001

ExcerptText: Every ticket is assigned a severity within one hour; severities are Low, Medium, High, Critical; High and Critical page the on-call agent.
Notes: Triage assignment + pager rule; evidence for C-002 and C-003

ExcerptText: Triage closes with one of four outcomes: resolved in first contact, escalated to engineering, marked duplicate, or routed to billing.
SLA is 4 hours for High/Critical initial response, 1 business day for Low/Medium.
The biggest recurring issue is duplicate tickets… maybe fifteen percent of all tickets are duplicates.
Notes: Pain point + rough estimate; evidence for C-005

ExcerptText: Escalations to engineering are the slowest path; agents sometimes escalate without reproduction steps; engineering sends it back, adds another half day.
Notes: Escalation-quality pain point; evidence for C-006
